textBox.richText: Lindsey and Austin - Air Force Academy, Cadet Chapel

My name is Lindsey Noble. My husband Austin and I were married on July 28th, 2012 by Paul Anderson. Working with Paul was easy and stress-free, which was quite the relief to me because I was planning our Colorado wedding from Illinois. He communicated regularly with me and always responded quickly to my emails or questions. Paul was flexible, professional and easy to work with. He worked with us and made sure that the ceremony was exactly what we wanted. He also brought his warmth and wisdom, which added a personal touch to the ceremony. It felt as if the ceremony was being performed by someone we knew our whole lives. I feel very blessed to have had Paul as our chaplain. He made our day memorable and special.
